reuse.why: Moves weekend occurrences through the shared getDateWithWeekendRule and reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, but re-derives the daily-skip condition inline and parses days with new Date(`${start}T00:00:00`) instead of the months utilities.

duplication.why: The daily-schedule skip test (frequency === 'daily' && skipWeekend && isWeekend) repeats the condition already inlined in getNextDate rather than being shared, and the RSchedule construction mirrors getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler lives in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates and is registered like its siblings; the daily-skip rule would better live in shared/schedules.ts with the move rule.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Workable, but the skip-vs-move rule now has two independent copies, the window margin uses take:count as a proxy, and long unformatted lines hurt readability.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Moving goes through getDateWithWeekendRule; no existing daily-skip helper exists to bypass (the duplicated condition is counted under duplication).

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip condition is copied in plain form from getNextDate, not disguised.
